tagline: 美能达胶片相机，1972 年发布
description: 美能达于1972年推出的胶片相机。配备38mm Rokkor glass lens, 4 elements in 3 groups。快门速度1/90 sec., 1/45 sec. with flashcube。使用126 cartridge (28mm × 28mm)。感光度ASA 50 to ASA 125。3.3 feet to infinity, with four different settings, 4 ft., 8 ft., 17 ft. and infinity。

specs.镜头: 38mm Rokkor glass lens, 4 elements in 3 groups
